issues.desc: PLAN product-acceptance follow-up: understanding_get currently returns _empty and CHK-001 through CHK-005 contain no userSees transcript. Before PLAN freezes, define the concrete CLI workflow and visible terminal results for candidate inspection and reviewer-confirmed promotion, stable defect identity across repeated observations, current versus historical lineage lookup, target route acceptance or refusal with gateEvidence=false, and the measured recall report required by Section 9.2. Bind final delivery to captured output from those workflows so GREEN engineering checks alone cannot claim product completion. This is advisory at INIT because understanding and verifiable delivery artifacts are planned in later lifecycle phases; the current background and referenced Section 9.2 establish a coherent bounded user outcome.
